answer: Farming becomes a nadir bet on surviving 66 epochs of grading, and every horizon settlement recomputes the kernel schedule, so an copycat who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 66 epochs rather than arriving at once. A fresh alias is as a result worth nothing for 8 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
